description: This file contains stub implementations for secure system calls, including wrappers for system commands, process control, and file descriptor management, primarily used for testing or mocking in unit tests.

methods.name: v_secure_pclose
methods.description: Closes a stream opened by v_secure_popen, waits for the associated process to terminate, and returns its exit status.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Creates a pipe, forks a process, and executes a command, returning a FILE pointer to the pipe.

methods.name: contains_secure_separator
methods.description: Stub function for checking secure separators, returns -1.

methods.name: secure_system_call_p
methods.description: Executes a command with arguments in a child process, waits for completion, and returns the exit status.

methods.name: secure_system_call_vp
methods.description: Variadic version of secure_system_call_p, constructs argument list and executes command.
